_doc: DEPROT-1 baseline, shrink-only: manifests that have no Dependabot entry yet. The entries belong in .github/dependabot.yml, a protected path that a model branch cannot edit (worker-gate); the ready file is in Q-DEPROT-dependabot. Each entry leaves this list in the same change that adds its Dependabot entry; the check fails on a baseline entry that is already covered, and on a new manifest that is in neither place.
